payload.title: Import the Anthus budget papyrus-amplify-monthly with a template that matches it exactly
payload.description: Read-only facts (2026-11-11): monthly COST budget 72.78 USD, cost filter Service = AWS Amplify, all eleven cost-type flags as in budget.yaml, one notification (ACTUAL > 100%), one subscriber of type SNS (an existing topic), no tags, no actions, in no stack. NotificationsWithSubscribers and BudgetName are create-only, so the template must declare them exactly or the import is refused. Add a variant account stack (cost filters, a notification and subscriber list as parameters, SNS subscriber type) and the dry-run per PPY-b5ddec. Leave the budget hand-made until then. amplify-cost-check.mjs reads it by name.
